scripts.test:unit: tsx --test test/generator.test.ts test/merge-issues.test.ts test/patch-schema.test.ts test/override-vocabulary.test.ts test/override-members.test.ts test/canonical-names.test.ts test/canonical-rename.test.ts test/verify-names.test.ts test/verify-gecko-pin.test.ts test/verify-exclusions.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run build && npm run check:artifacts && npm run check:pruned && npm run verify:widening && npm run verify:gecko-pin && npm run verify:names && npm run verify:override-vocabulary && npm run verify:override-members && npm run enforce:zero-any && npm run test && npm run verify:dist && npm run verify:artifacts && npm run verify:derivation && npm run verify:patches && npm run verify:exclusions && npm run verify:evidence && npm run ratchet:unions
